title: MULTICENTER, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, PHASE III STUDY TO EVALUATE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF CLR-07-23 (HEPARAN SULFATE 120 MG PROLONGED-RELEASE TABLETS) IN THE TREATMENT OF PRIMARY CHRONIC VENOUS DISEASE.
official: MULTICENTER, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, PHASE III STUDY TO EVALUATE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF CLR-07-23 (HEPARAN SULFATE 120 MG PROLONGED-RELEASE TABLETS) IN THE TREATMENT OF PRIMARY CHRONIC VENOUS DISEASE.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the superiority in terms of efficacy of the heparan sulfate 120 mg prolonged-release tablets compared to placebo in patients with primary chronic venous disease of the lower limbs.
conditions: PRIMARY CHRONIC VENOUS DISEASE OF THE LOWER LIMBS
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants with an age ≥ 18 and ≤ 80 years
2. Diagnosed primary venous disease of the lower limbs in stage C2 – C5according to the CEAP classification, involvement of the venous systemof the lower limbs is verified by duplex ultrasonography
3. Presence of objective signs and subjective symptoms of the disease(classified according to rVCSS score ≥ 4)
4. Participants not using or planning to use compression therapy by theirown decision
5. Provision of written informed consent as approved by the EthicsCommittee (EC)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Use of a venoactive drug in the last month
2. Diabetic foot syndrome
3. Refractory (uncontrollable) hypertension (inability to therapeutically achieve a systolic blood pressure ≤ 160 mmHg or a diastolic blood pressure ≤ 100 mmHg)
4. Symptomatic ischemic disease of lower limbs
5. Lymphoedema: primary, posttraumatic, postoperative, post-radiation, malignant
6. Manual/instrumental lymphatic drainage in the last 3 months
7. Invasive procedure on the lower limbs in the last 6 months
8. Trauma of the lower extremity that has not fully healed
9. Use of oral/parenteral anticoagulants
10. Use of dual antiplatelet therapy
11. Use of loop diuretics
12. Regular use of compression therapy or use of mechanical devices forreduction of edema in the last month
13. Use of oestrogens or progesterone and its derivates
14. Use of oral/parental corticosteroids in the last 6 weeks
15. Chronic pain treatment ≥ 14 days
16. Use of psychopharmaceuticals affecting fluid retention (antipsychotics, combined antidepressants)
17. Severe obesity (BMI > 40 kg/m2)
18. Participants with active malignant disease or malignant disease in remission for less than 5 years
19. Myeloproliferative or immune disorders
20. Contraindications to the IMP/Placebo administration
21. Hypersensitivity to the IMP/Placebo excipients.
22. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
23. Heart Failure (NYHA class III and IV), congestive heart failure withperipheral edema
24. Women of child-bearing potential not using at least one effective contraceptive method for the entire trial
25. Participation in other investigational drug or device clinical trials within 30 days prior to study screening
26. Participants legally or mentally incapacitated unable to give informed consent for the participation in this trial
27. Participants unable or unwilling to comply with appointments or all protocol requirements
28. eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m² at screening or chronic kidney diseasedocumented in the medical history
29. ALT or AST more than 3 times the upper limit of normal range atscreening or advanced liver disease documented in the medical history
30. Deep venous thrombosis lower limb thrombosis and / or documentedresidual venous obstruction or deep venous reflux due to post-thromboticalterations in the deep venous system
31. Superficial venous thrombosis of the lower limbs in the previous 6 months
32. Congenital venous/lymphatic malformation
33. Neuropathy of any aetiology
